chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad and al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUbayd Allāh, from a number of our companions, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from al-Washshāʾ, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about semen that gets on a garment. He said: “If you know its place, then wash it; but if its place is hidden from you, then wash all of it.”

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing that has been affected
key_terms.الْمَنِيِّ: semen, treated here as a substance affecting ritual purity
key_terms.خَفِيَ: was hidden or unknown, referring to uncertainty about the impure spot
key_terms.فَاغْسِلْهُ: then wash it, indicating the required act of purification
key_terms.كُلَّهُ: all of it, meaning the entire garment must be washed when the place is unknown
key_terms.مَكَانَهُ: its location, meaning the exact spot of impurity

ai.seo_question: What should be done if semen gets on a garment and its exact place is unknown?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding ritual purity of clothing when contaminated by semen. If the exact impure spot is known, only that place must be washed; if it is unknown, the entire garment must be washed to ensure taharah.
